title: Matryoshka dimension-budget Mirror readout
hypothesis: At the same prefix dimension, one task/budget-specific Givens coordinate at the prefix boundary can improve SciFact held-out retrieval quality over the native Matryoshka prefix, while using the same materialized candidate vector bytes plus a negligible coordinate, and the gain will exceed a matched normalized two-coordinate linear readout control.
physical_object: Nomic Embed v1.5 full 768-D query/document encoder and full-dimensional corpus embedding table.
mirror_coordinate: One float32 angle per prefix budget, rotating dimensions d-1 and d before taking the first d coordinates and renormalizing.
logical_multiplicity: Five retrieval quality/latency functions at nested dimensions 64, 128, 256, 512, and 768.

data.development: BeIR/scifact-qrels train.tsv: 809 query IDs, 919 qrels rows
data.fresh_audit: BeIR/scifact-qrels test.tsv: 300 disjoint query IDs, 339 qrels rows
data.relevance: positive qrels only; exact full-corpus retrieval
data.seeds: none; frozen pretrained encoder and fixed disjoint benchmark query split

embedding.pooling: masked mean, full-dimension layer norm, then full-vector L2 normalization, matching the model card

controls: native Matryoshka prefix at each dimension
Mirror boundary Givens angle chosen on train qrels at each dimension
matched normalized two-coordinate linear boundary readout (same function family as Givens, tested for exact alias)

selection.selection_metric: mean development nDCG@10 over train-qrels query IDs
selection.selection_unit: one angle per budget; 768-D view fixed to zero because a full orthogonal rotation preserves cosine similarity
selection.audit_isolation: test qrels are opened only after protocol freeze and development selection lock

metrics.storage: actual .npy serialized source vector table, per-budget candidate vector index, model/tokenizer/code, per-budget coordinate and manifest bytes
compute: exact retrieval wall time and queries/s

success_gate: At least two of the four sub-full dimensions improve test nDCG@10 by >=0.5 percentage points over native prefix; no sub-full dimension regresses by >0.5 points; the complete materialized Mirror bank is <=1.01x matched native candidate bytes; and median retrieval throughput is >=90% of native. A Mirror-specific PASS additionally requires >=0.2 point nDCG@10 improvement over the matched normalized linear boundary control.
failure_gate: No qualifying held-out quality-cost point, materialized Mirror payload exceeds 1.01x native candidate bank, a matched simple control ties the Mirror function/quality, or full-dimension Mirror changes rankings despite exact orthogonality.

paid_objects: each materialized native or Mirror candidate vector table
storage.queries: test query texts and temporary query vectors are input/work state, not persistent retrieval index state; their hashes and embedding replay are recorded
storage.full_payload_rule: common encoder and source table are charged to every complete method bank; all budget-specific candidate banks and coordinate metadata are also charged

boundaries: one natural scientific retrieval benchmark and one pretrained encoder
no encoder fine-tuning; task/budget views selected only on train qrels
exact dense full-corpus retrieval, not ANN index latency
the full-dimension orthogonal gauge is an invariance check, not independent capacity
